common.attachmentKeptTip: This record already has an attachment (ID {0}); uploading a new file replaces it
common.attachmentTip: Some leave types (sick / marriage / maternity) require an attachment; images / PDF / Office / zip, max 10MB
common.noEmployeeProfile: The current account has no employee record, cannot submit a request

employee.deleteConfirmTip: Delete the employee record of "{0}"? The linked login account is kept
employee.keywordTip: Fuzzy search by remark / emergency contact
employee.managerTip: Only source of the approval chain "Direct Manager" node; cannot be yourself, empty = not set
employee.sensitiveKeepTip: Leave empty to keep the current value
employee.title: Employee Records
employee.userIdTip: Only existing accounts; deleted accounts cannot be selected

flow.approverHelp: Only used by node types 3/4 (3 = specific user, sys_user.id; 4 = specific role, sys_role.id); for 1 direct manager / 2 dept leader the backend resolves the approver from the applicant org, this field is ignored
flow.approverRoleTip: Select an approver role (disabled roles are not selectable)
flow.approverUserTip: Select a specific approver (deleted accounts are disabled)
flow.bizTypeHelp: Values come from the approvalBizType dictionary; creating a template for a soft-deleted business type restores the original row instead of inserting a new one
flow.deleteConfirmTip: Delete approval flow "{0}"? The backend rejects deletion while pending instances exist
flow.keywordTip: Fuzzy match on business type / template name
flow.lastNodeSkipTip: The last node cannot be skipped (otherwise the request would stall when no approver can be resolved)
flow.name: Template Name
flow.nodeDeleteConfirmTip: Delete node "{0}"? The backend rejects it when the new last node is configured to skip
flow.seqHelp: Ascending from 1, unique within the template; at most 20 nodes per template
flow.skipIfEmptyHelp: The last node must not be skippable (choose "No"), otherwise the backend rejects the write
flow.title: Approval Flow

todo.opinionTip: Optional approval opinion, up to 255 characters
todo.rejectConfirm: Reject the request of "{0}"? The instance becomes rejected immediately and cannot be restored

instance.cancelConfirm: Cancel the request of "{0}"? The pending instance becomes canceled immediately

record.clearClockTip: Clearing submits an empty string (the backend clears that clock time)
record.clockOrderError: Clock out cannot be earlier than clock in
record.importErrClock: Clock time must be yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
record.importErrClockOrder: Clock out cannot be earlier than clock in
record.importErrEmployee: Exactly one of employeeId / userId is required
record.importErrEmployeeId: employeeId / userId must be an integer greater than 0
record.importErrExternalId: External record ID cannot exceed 64 characters
record.importErrObject: Each row must be a JSON object
record.importErrSource: source must be 1-5 (1 import, 2 manual, 3 device, 4 DingTalk, 5 Feishu)
record.importExample: Example (field names match the backend ImportRecordRow)
record.importNeedText: Paste the JSON row array to import first
record.importNotArray: The top level must be a row array ([...])
record.importPlaceholder: Paste the normalized JSON row array, then click "Validate" to preview (fields: employeeId / userId, one of them, workDate, clockIn, clockOut, source, externalId, remark)
record.importRowsError: The row count must be between 1 and {0}
record.importTip: Paste a normalized JSON row array (the integration surface for third-party attendance platforms): exactly one of employeeId / userId per row (userId is resolved to a profile by the server), an empty externalId is treated as "no external ID"; at most 1000 rows per import and any invalid row aborts the submission.

schedule.batchEmployeeTip: Multiple selection, up to 1000 employees per batch
schedule.batchLimitTip: Batch scheduling upserts per employee per day: at most 1000 employees, at most 366 days, at most 10000 rows per batch; pick the "Rest" shift to schedule rest days.

shift.title: Shift
shift.shiftCodeTip: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only; globally unique
shift.crossDayTip: Yes means the end time falls on the next day and the window extends by 24 hours
shift.keywordTip: Fuzzy search by shift code / name
shift.windowTip: Work minutes plus rest minutes must not exceed the shift window (validated by the backend; the window is capped per day)
shift.windowExceededTip: Work + rest exceeds the shift window {0}; the backend will reject the request
shift.endBeforeStartTip: For a non-cross-day shift, the end time must be later than the start time
shift.crossDayOrderTip: For a cross-day shift, the end time must not be later than the start time (equal means a 24-hour window)
shift.deleteConfirmTip: Delete shift "{0}"? Shifts are soft-deleted so historical schedules keep their name

calendar.title: Work Calendar
calendar.isWorkdayTip: No means the day is not counted as attendance-required (e.g. a statutory holiday)
calendar.holidayTypeTip: Statutory holiday = "No" + "Statutory Holiday"; adjusted workday = "Yes" + "Adjusted Workday"
calendar.standardMinutesTip: Base for attendance conversion on that day (minutes), 1-1440, default 480
calendar.importRangeTip: Written day by day: existing dates are updated, missing ones created; up to 366 days per import
calendar.importRangeTooLongTip: The import range must not exceed {0} days

overtime.title: Overtime Request
overtime.timeRangeTip: Start and end time must fall on the overtime date; split cross-day overtime into separate requests
overtime.overtimeTypeTip: Workday overtime must avoid the working window of the day; rest day / public holiday requires a non-working day
overtime.compModeTip: Time off in lieu: a time-off grant is generated once approved (valid for 3 calendar months from the overtime date); Overtime pay: the request is recorded without amount
overtime.compTimeOffTip: A time-off grant was generated on approval, valid for 3 calendar months from the overtime date
overtime.submitConfirm: Resubmit this overtime request? It will re-enter the approval flow
overtime.cancelConfirm: Cancel this overtime request? You can edit and resubmit it from the list afterwards
overtime.deleteConfirm: Delete this overtime request? A pending approval will be canceled as well
overtime.editTip: Only rejected or canceled overtime requests can be edited; resubmit from the list afterwards

request.readOnlyTip: Read-only (HR view): update / submit / cancel / delete are limited to the applicant

myRequest.cancelConfirm: Cancel this leave request? The locked balance will be released.
myRequest.createTip: Create and submit in one step: it enters approval and locks balance immediately. Duration is derived from the schedule and work calendar.
myRequest.deleteConfirm: Delete leave request #{0}? This cannot be undone.
myRequest.editTip: Only rejected / canceled requests can be edited; submit it again afterwards.
myRequest.submitConfirm: Submit this leave request? It enters approval and locks balance.
myRequest.title: Leave request

type.deleteConfirmTip: Delete leave type "{0}"? Its code stays occupied, and a type with balance batches cannot be deleted
type.minUnitMinutesTip: In minutes; 240 = half day, 480 = one day
type.title: Leave Type
type.typeCodeTip: Lowercase letters / digits / underscore, globally unique (including deleted records)

grant.batchResultAllSkipped: {0} employee(s) in scope were already granted with the same reason this period; no batch created
grant.batchResultNone: No employee in scope is eligible; no batch created
grant.batchResultPartial: Granted balance to {0} employee(s); {1} skipped because the same reason was already granted this period
grant.cancelConfirmTip: Cancel the "{1}" grant of "{0}"? The remaining balance will be reversed and this cannot be undone
grant.deptIdTip: Only employees attached to this department, excluding sub-departments
grant.employeeIdsTip: Up to 1000 employees per request; employees already granted with the same reason this period are skipped
grant.expireAtTip: Leave empty for permanent validity; must not be earlier than the effective date
grant.minutesTip: In minutes; follow the type's minimum unit (e.g. 240 = half day, 480 = one day)
grant.periodTip: e.g. 2026; forms the idempotency key together with the reason
